title: Volcano eruption disrupts hundreds of flights at Southeast Asia's second-busiest airport
summary: The recent eruption of Mount Anak Krakatau has caused significant disruptions to air travel in Indonesia, affecting hundreds of flights. The impact of the volcanic activity has led to numerous cancellations, with further delays anticipated into Monday. This incident highlights the ongoing challenges posed by natural disasters on regional travel and the importance of timely communication from airlines and authorities.
shadowing: The eruption of Mount Anak Krakatau has caused significant disruptions.
Hundreds of flights have been canceled across Indonesia.
Travelers are advised to check with their airlines for updates.
The volcanic activity is expected to continue affecting air travel.
Authorities are monitoring the situation closely.
